He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor Bears]]. ==Early life== Missi was born on 14 May 2004.{{Cite web|url=https://www.nbadraft.net/players/yves-missi/|website=NBADraft.net|title=Yves Missi}} He was born in [[Belgium]] but grew up in [[Cameroon]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/prospect-profiles/nba-draft-scouting-report-baylors-yves-missi|website=[[Sports Illustrated]]|title=NBA Draft Scouting Report: Baylor's Yves Missi|date=11 September 2023}}{{Cite web|url=https://michigan.rivals.com/news/well-traveled-five-star-yves-missi-is-here|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=14 July 2022|title=Well-traveled five-star Yves Missi is here|author=Moseley, Davis|url-access=subscription}} He moved to the United States in 2021 and began attending [[West Nottingham Academy]] in Maryland.{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/syracuse/recruiting/yves-missi-developed-high-major-recruit|website=[[Sports Illustrated]]|title=Yves Missi Has Developed Into a High Major Prospect|author=McCallister, Mike|date=5 May 2022}} He later transferred to [[Prolific Prep]] in [[Napa, California]], and averaged 9.3 points, 8.7 rebounds and 1.3 blocks per game.{{Cite news|url=https://baylorlariat.com/2023/11/06/bears-add-depth-get-to-know-fresh-faces-of-baylor-mens-basketball/|newspaper=[[The Baylor Lariat]]|title=Bears add depth: Get to know fresh faces of Baylor men’s basketball|date=6 November 2023|author=Nicholas, Foster}} A five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]], he was highly recruited and was ranked by [[ESPN]] as the second-best player in California, the 13th-best player nationally and third-best [[Center (basketball)|center]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/35380294/top-25-junior-missi-chooses-baylor-right-place-me|publisher=[[ESPN]]|title=Top 25 junior Missi chooses Baylor, 'the right place for me'|date=4 January 2023|author=Biancardi, Paul; Borzello, Jeff}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.co.uk/recruiting/basketball/story/_/id/37327961/yves-missi-reclassifies-2023-class-baylor-basketball|publisher=[[ESPN]]|title=Yves Missi reclassifies to 2023 class for Baylor basketball|date=3 May 2023|author=Borzello, Jeff}} Missi played at the [[Nike Hoop Summit]] in 2023 and won The Grind Session World Championship with Prolific Prep, earning a place at the GEICO High School Nationals.{{Cite web|url=https://baylorbears.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/yves-missi/12472|publisher=[[Baylor Bears]]|title=Yves Missi}} He also played in the [[Nike Elite Youth Basketball League]] (EYBL) and averaged 12.7 points, 9.9 rebounds and 2.8 blocks per game with the PSA Cardinals.{{Cite news|url=https://wacotrib.com/sports/college/baylor/missi-commits-to-baylor-mens-basketball/article_f7d889dc-8c89-11ed-b47f-c3714b0229c0.html|newspaper=[[Waco Tribune-Herald]]|url-access=subscription|title=Missi commits to Baylor men's basketball|date=4 January 2023}} He committed to playing college basketball for the [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor Bears]] and reclassified to be able to join them for the 2023–24 season.{{Cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/college-basketball-recruiting-baylor-commit-yves-missi-reclassifies-will-join-bears-for-2023-24-season/|publisher=[[CBS Sports]]|title=College basketball recruiting: Baylor commit Yves Missi reclassifies, will join Bears for 2023-24 season |author=Salerno, Cameron|date=3 May 2023}} ==College career== Missi impressed early in the 2023–24 Baylor season and has been projected as a potential pick in the [[2024 NBA draft]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/2024-nba-draft-breaking-down-baylors-yves-missi|website=[[Sports
